name: DlightRAG · a mountpoint is at least 85% full
message: a read-write mountpoint is at least 85% full; the fullest one in the bucket that breached reads {{value}} (used over used plus free). free space on the host before the next write fails, and find what grew.

chartConfig.name: filesystem utilization per mountpoint
chartConfig.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ts, mountpoint, used / (used + free) AS utilization
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
         Attributes['mountpoint'] AS mountpoint,
         maxIf(Value, Attributes['state'] = 'used') AS used,
         maxIf(Value, Attributes['state'] = 'free') AS free
  FROM otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName = 'system.filesystem.usage'
    AND Attributes['mode'] = 'rw'
    AND $__timeFilter_ms(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY ts, mountpoint
  HAVING used + free > 0
)
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 1000
